copy.tagline: 设计游戏化任务界面的三屏原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计带经验值系统的任务应用界面。
copy.tagline_en: Design a gamified three-screen task interface with XP and dark theme.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a task app interface with XP system and dark mode.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会输出一套游戏化 App 的三屏设计稿:暗色舞台上并排三个 iPhone 画框——封面海报、带 XP 进度条与等级缎带的今日任务、含子任务与奖励的任务详情。
howto.when: 需要三个 iPhone 屏并排展示的类 RPG 习惯养成或任务型 App 界面时触发;默认产出封面、今日任务、任务详情三屏。

say.text: 用 gamified-app 做一套三屏任务 App 的展示稿
say.note: 会生成封面、今日任务、任务详情三屏

say.text: 把今日任务屏的等级缎带和 XP 进度条再突出一点
say.note: 调整第二屏的等级与 XP 元素

say.text: 任务详情屏加上子任务列表和奖励区
say.note: 第三屏补上子任务与奖励

howto.what_en: After install, Claude outputs a three-screen gamified app mockup on a dark showcase stage: a cover/poster phone, today's quests with an XP ribbon and level bar, and a quest detail screen with subtasks and rewards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want an RPG-style habit or quest app shown as three side-by-side iPhone frames: cover, today's quests, and quest detail.

say_en.text: Make a three-screen quest app showcase with gamified-app
say_en.note: Gives cover, today's quests, and quest detail screens

say_en.text: Push the level ribbon and XP bar on the today's quests screen
say_en.note: Tweaks the second screen's level and XP elements

say_en.text: Add a subtask list and reward area to the quest detail screen
say_en.note: Adds subtasks and rewards to the third screen
